say:3:1323202002:1.text: Hurry up and get ready! Set up your rod, and... wait a second. You're not here for the crystalfin, are you?
say:3:1323202002:1.source_cn: 赶紧收拾呀！架起你的鱼竿，撑起你的……等等，你不是来钓...
say:3:1323202002:1.male: Hurry up and get ready! Set up your rod, and... wait a second. You're not here for the crystalfin, are you?
say:3:1323202002:1.female: Hurry up and get ready! Set up your rod, and... wait a second. You're not here for the crystalfin, are you?

say:6:1323202005:1.text: You don't know what the crystalfin is?! It's the legend of Cedartown, the myth of the Duchy of Whiteridge, the dream catch of every fisherman!
say:6:1323202005:1.source_cn: 雾凇影你都不知道？！那可是雪松镇的传说，白山公国的神话...

say:7:1323202006:1.text: So the crystalfin is a fish from Whiteridge?
say:7:1323202006:1.source_cn: 所以雾凇影是白山的一条鱼？

say:8:1323202007:0.text: It's not just any fish! It's the Fish King!
say:8:1323202007:0.source_cn: 它可不是一般的鱼！它是鱼王！

say:9:1323202008:1.text: It's the most elusive shadow under the ice... When the first light of dawn breaks and frost forms on the treetops—that's when it frolics beneath the ice.
say:9:1323202008:1.source_cn: 那可是冰下最神秘的身影……每当晨曦初现，太阳刚露头那会...

say:10:1323202009:1.text: Countless seasoned fishermen have camped on the ice at dawn, only to leave empty-handed amid the morning mist. They say catching it is harder than finding a fisherman who doesn't brag at the tavern.
say:10:1323202009:1.source_cn: 多少老钓手为了它，大清早就在冰面上扎营，结果只能跟着晨...

say:11:1323202010:1.text: I've been waiting here for ages to try my luck. See, my tent's still over there!
say:11:1323202010:1.source_cn: 我可是在这里蹲守了好久，就为了钓到它——你瞧，我的帐篷...

say:12:1323202011:1.text: You stayed out here all night? This area is dangerous...
say:12:1323202011:1.source_cn: 你直接在这里过夜吗？这附近很危险啊……

say:13:1323202012:1.text: You don't understand. This place is remote, and the crystalfin likes the quiet. The fewer people around, the better your chances.
say:13:1323202012:1.source_cn: 这你就不懂了吧？这地方偏，雾凇影喜静，没人的地方更容易钓到。

say:14:1323202013:1.text: A dedicated fisherman if I've ever seen one...

say:15:1323202014:1.text: He's so full of hope for catching the crystalfin...
say:15:1323202014:1.source_cn: 他对钓雾凇影充满了憧憬呢……

say:16:1323202015:1.text: Exactly! Everyone in the fishing community knows the crystalfin. If I could catch it, I'd release every fish I've ever caught. It'd be worth it!
say:16:1323202015:1.source_cn: 可不是嘛，整个钓圈没有人不知道雾凇影。要是能钓到它，让...

choice_prompt:17:1323202015.text: Exactly! Everyone in the fishing community knows the crystalfin. If I could catch it, I'd release every fish I've ever caught. It'd be worth it!
choice_prompt:17:1323202015.source_cn: 可不是嘛，整个钓圈没有人不知道雾凇影。要是能钓到它，让我把这辈子钓到的所有鱼都放生也值！

say:18:1323202016:0.text: Don't be so shallow! Fishing isn't about numbers. It's about the experience... the feeling!
say:18:1323202016:0.source_cn: 钓鱼钓的是种意境！是种感觉……数量并不重要。
say:18:1323202016:0.male: Don't be so shallow! Fishing isn't about numbers. It's about the experience... the feeling!
say:18:1323202016:0.female: Don't be so shallow! Fishing isn't about numbers. It's about the experience... the feeling!

say:20:1323202018:1.text: Chippy's getting curious about this mysterious Fish King. Magister, why don't we stay and watch?
say:20:1323202018:1.source_cn: 满满也有点好奇神秘的鱼王了。主人，不如我们留下来看看吧。
say:20:1323202018:1.male: Chippy's getting curious about this mysterious Fish King. Magister, why don't we stay and watch?
say:20:1323202018:1.female: Chippy's getting curious about this mysterious Fish King. Magister, why don't we stay and watch?

say:21:1323202019:1.text: You want to stay and watch me catch the crystalfin? Well, I don't mind... but I'm out of bait, and I could use someone's help gathering the materials.
say:21:1323202019:1.source_cn: 你想留下来见证我钓上雾凇影？这个嘛，也不是不行……正巧...
say:21:1323202019:1.male: You want to stay and watch me catch the crystalfin? Well, I don't mind... but I'm out of bait, and I could use someone's help gathering the materials.
say:21:1323202019:1.female: You want to stay and watch me catch the crystalfin? Well, I don't mind... but I'm out of bait, and I could use someone's help gathering the materials.
